First build for Fallout 4 **Next-Gen (runtime 1.10.984)**.

## Requirements

- Fallout 4 1.10.984
- F4SE 0.7.2
- Address Library for F4SE Plugins (1.10.984)

## Install

Install `CustomMeshesPathF4-v2.0.0.zip` with your mod manager, or copy the contents of its `F4SE\Plugins` folder into `Data\F4SE\Plugins`.

Updating an existing install? Existing `CustomMeshesPathF4_Rules.txt` files work unchanged, but the zip contains the default rules file. To keep your own rules, replace only `CustomMeshesPathF4.dll`, which is also attached on its own.

For the old-gen game (1.10.163), keep using the build in `legacy/1.10.163` in the repository.

## Changes

- Rebuilt for F4SE 0.7.2 and runtime 1.10.984.
- Now requires Address Library for F4SE Plugins.
- When the game starts, the plugin checks that both hooked addresses are function starts and that the file-open hook is the one the game calls with a `meshes\` folder. If a check fails, it disables itself and explains why in `Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\CustomMeshesPathF4.log`.
- A `#` comment after a rule no longer breaks that rule.
- An invalid form ID in the rules file is logged instead of crashing the game.
- Smaller fixes: reloading the rules is safe while meshes load on other threads, an actor keeps its custom paths if another actor is loaded in the middle of it, and replacing the body-morph (`BODYTRI`) path no longer leaks the old string.

## Known limitations

- This build was tested outside the game but has not yet been confirmed in-game. Please open an issue, with `CustomMeshesPathF4.log` attached, if the log says the hooks could not be installed, if your custom meshes are not applied, or if the game crashes while actors load.
- Only loose files are used as replacements; meshes packed in `.ba2` archives are not detected.

## Third-party code

The DLL contains MinHook and the Hacker Disassembler Engine (BSD 2-Clause). The license is in the zip (`F4SE\Plugins\CustomMeshesPathF4\MinHook-LICENSE.txt`) and in the repository's `licenses` folder.
